Viewport Preview
Viewport Preview

The viewport shows the map pieces and assets of a map, lit by the selected GPARAM, including its unsaved edits. Switch the viewport to Game render mode to see the lighting. Its time of day, weather and other lighting settings are in the Viewport Rendering section.
Maps can't be shown: the Map Editor has to be enabled for this project, its maps readable, and the Vulkan renderer in use.

Map
Pick a map to show the selected GPARAM on. Double-click a map to load it.
Actions
Load, frame or unload the map shown in the viewport.
Load GPARAM's Map
Loads the map the selected GPARAM belongs to.
Load Picked Map
Loads the map picked in the list above.
Frame Map
Moves the camera so the whole map is in view.
Unload Map
Removes the map from the viewport.
Options
How the map is chosen and loaded.
Load the GPARAM's map when it is selected
When a GPARAM of a map is selected, its map is loaded into the viewport.
Load assets
Shows the map's assets (objects) as well as its map pieces. Applies the next time a map is loaded.
Time of Day
The viewport is lit at the Map Editor's time of day and weather, set in the Viewport Rendering section's Map Lighting tab, so both editors light a map alike.
Follow the selected value's time
When a value of a field that changes through the day is selected, the viewport is lit at that value's time of day instead of the Map Editor's.
